setup_text: Between floors, the party finds faded writing carved deep into the stone wall. The symbols are old -- older than the dungeon itself. {slot_0} leans in to study them while {slot_1} keeps watch.

dialogue.line: 'These markings... I think they're a warning. Or maybe directions. I need more time to figure it out.'
'We don't have time. Could be a trap for all we know.'
'Or it could be the key to understanding what this place really is.'

choices.label: Study the inscription
choices.description: Take time to decipher the ancient writing.

marks.name: Deciphered inscription on floor {floor}
marks.origin: Studied ancient writing between dungeon floors

choices.label: Keep moving
choices.description: The dungeon is dangerous enough without stopping to read walls.

llm_context.scene_mood: Mysterious and tense. Ancient secrets in a dangerous place.

slot_guidance.tone: Excited and intellectually driven. Can't resist a mystery.
Practical and wary. Prioritizes safety over curiosity.
